title: Mob Psycho 100: A Quiet Boy with Great Powers
summary: Mob Psycho 100 is a manga and anime story about a quiet boy with unusual powers.

cover.alt: In a sunlit study, a teen in a navy hoodie lifts a hand while a notebook and yellow pencil float, as a mentor in a terracotta cardigan and a woman in a green shirt watch.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Mob Psycho 100 is a manga and anime story about a quiet boy with unusual powers.

items.prompt: What do you think makes a hero interesting?
What would you do if you had a special power?
What do you think a normal life means?

blocks.title: Part 1: Two Ways to Enjoy the Story
paragraphs: Mob Psycho 100 first appeared as a manga, or a Japanese comic series. ONE, a Japanese artist, wrote and drew it. The series began in 2012 and ended in 2017. ONE also made One-Punch Man. Later, Mob Psycho 100 became an anime, or an animated series. People could read the story on a page or watch it move on a screen.

images.alt: On a green sofa, a teen in a forest-green hoodie holds a book while a mentor in a burnt-orange cardigan and a woman in a cream sweater watch a vintage TV with colorful pictures.

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: Two Ways to Enjoy the Story

items.prompt: Who wrote and drew the original series?
items.answer: ONE wrote and drew the original series.

blocks.title: Part 2: Meet the Main Character
paragraphs: The main person is Shigeo Kageyama. People call him Mob. He is a quiet boy, but he has psychic powers. Psychic powers are unusual powers of the mind. Mob does not mainly want to be special. He wants a normal life. This difference is important: his powers are very big, but his wish is very ordinary.

blocks.title: Check: Part 2: Meet the Main Character

items.prompt: What kind of life does Mob want?

blocks.title: Part 3: A Simple Story Pattern
paragraphs: Mob works with Reigen Arataka. We can understand the story with three ideas: person, wish, and problem. The person is Mob. His wish is a normal life. The problem is that his psychic powers make his life unusual. Reigen is part of Mob's work. This pattern helps us understand the basic story without knowing every event.

images.alt: At a wooden kitchen table, a boy in a dark green sweater lifts a hand while two blank papers float, as two adults holding mugs watch kindly.

blocks.title: Check: Part 3: A Simple Story Pattern

items.prompt: Why is a normal life difficult for Mob?
items.answer: A normal life is difficult for Mob because he has unusual psychic powers.
items.explanation: What would you do if you had great powers but wanted a normal life?

blocks.title: Part 4: From Pages to the Screen
paragraphs: Bones, a Japanese animation studio, later made the anime. Its first season aired in 2016. A season is one group of TV episodes. More seasons followed in 2019 and 2022. These dates show the order clearly: ONE's comic story came first, and the animated version came later. The story moved from drawn pages to moving pictures and sound.

blocks.title: Check: Part 4: From Pages to the Screen

items.prompt: Which came first, the comic story or the animated version?

blocks.title: Part 5: The Story in One Idea
paragraphs: Now put the main facts together. ONE created the page version and wrote and drew Mob's story. Bones made the screen version later. In both forms, Shigeo “Mob” Kageyama is the quiet boy at the center. He has psychic powers, works with Reigen Arataka, and wants a normal life. Great power and an ordinary wish are the easiest way to explain the story.

blocks.title: Check: Part 5: The Story in One Idea
